description: This file defines the NetworkExceptionInterface interface within the Psr\Http\Client namespace, representing network-related exception scenarios in HTTP client operations.

classes.name: NetworkExceptionInterface
classes.description: An interface indicating network-related exceptions occurring during HTTP client operations, extending ClientExceptionInterface.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request object associated with the network exception; may differ from the original request passed to sendRequest().
